test_title: PYST 6: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements :**

Some ceilings are beds.

No bed is an apple.

All dogs are beds.

**Conclusions :**

I. Some ceilings being dogs is a possibility.

II. No dog is an apple.

III. All beds are dogs.

IV. No ceiling is an apple.

options.text: Only Conclusions I, II and IV follow
Only Conclusions II and III follow
Only Conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram that can be drawn is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/517c7f900a70a6d8ef825c7f826441bbc6840e1566d1e479bd466dc8a6a805ac.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some ceilings being dogs is a possibility → **Follows** (Because all dogs are beds and some beds are ceilings, so this is possible)
